title: Career Roadmap: Sustainability Analyst
summary: Evaluate environmental performance, energy consumption, emissions, resource use and sustainability initiatives to help organizations reduce environmental impacts, improve resource efficiency and meet sustainability goals.

facts.Current degree: Liberal Arts / Liberal Studies (BA / B.Sc Liberal Arts & Sciences)

about.label: Education Pathway
about.text: Liberal Arts / Liberal Studies – Environmental Studies & Sustainability

blocks.text: Evaluate environmental performance, energy consumption, emissions, resource use and sustainability initiatives to help organizations reduce environmental impacts, improve resource efficiency and meet sustainability goals.

rows.text: Any stream; Biology, Geography, Economics, Chemistry and Mathematics are useful
Liberal Arts degree in Environmental Studies & Sustainability
Climate change, ESG reporting, carbon accounting, renewable energy or sustainable business
Master's in Environmental Management, Sustainability, Climate Policy, Energy Management or Environmental Science

blocks.label: Alternative pathways
blocks.text: Environmental Science, Geography, Economics, Engineering or Business degrees with sustainability-related electives and practical projects.

blocks.label: Environmental Knowledge
blocks.text: Climate change, resource efficiency, waste management and environmental indicators.

blocks.label: Data Analysis
blocks.text: Excel, statistics, data cleaning and visualization.

blocks.label: Carbon Accounting
blocks.text: Understanding greenhouse-gas emissions, emissions factors and Scope 1, 2 and 3 concepts.

blocks.label: Reporting
blocks.text: Sustainability reports, KPI tracking and evidence-based recommendations.

blocks.label: Standards Awareness
blocks.text: Familiarity with GHG Protocol, GRI and relevant ESG reporting frameworks.

blocks.label: Communication
blocks.text: Research, stakeholder engagement and explaining sustainability performance to non-specialists.
Build three or four practical projects:

blocks.label: Carbon Footprint Assessment
blocks.text: Estimate emissions for a sample office, campus or event using documented assumptions.

blocks.label: Energy Analysis
blocks.text: Analyse electricity consumption and identify potential efficiency improvements.

blocks.label: Sustainability Dashboard
blocks.text: Visualize energy, water, waste and emissions indicators using Excel or Power BI.

blocks.label: ESG Report Review
blocks.text: Compare sustainability disclosures from two organizations.

blocks.label: Waste Reduction Plan
blocks.text: Recommend measurable actions and define monitoring indicators.
Document data sources, calculation methods, assumptions, limitations and suggested improvements.
Target placements at:

items.text: Climate research organizations and think tanks.
NGOs working on conservation or sustainable development.
Sustainability and environmental management teams in manufacturing and technology companies.

blocks.text: Search for Sustainability Intern, ESG Analyst Intern, Environmental Research Intern, Climate Policy Intern and Carbon Accounting Intern roles.
Prioritize:

items.text: Greenhouse-gas accounting and the GHG Protocol.
Environmental management systems, including ISO 14001 concepts.
Excel and Power BI for sustainability data.
Climate policy and sustainable business practices.

blocks.text: Verify certification-provider credibility and employer relevance before paying for a course.
Sustainability / ESG Intern
Junior Sustainability Analyst
Sustainability Analyst / ESG Analyst
Senior Analyst → Sustainability Manager / ESG Lead
Progression depends on analytical ability, reporting experience, sector expertise and the organization's sustainability requirements.

items.text: Energy Efficiency Analyst, with relevant training

rows.text: Learn sustainability indicators, ESG fundamentals, emissions concepts and Excel.
Complete a carbon-footprint or energy-analysis project and build a simple dashboard.
Review corporate sustainability reports, prepare a portfolio and apply for relevant internships.

blocks.label: Target-ready profile
blocks.text: Environmental and ESG knowledge, data-analysis skills, familiarity with sustainability reporting and emissions calculations, and a portfolio demonstrating measurable environmental insights.
